policy: Bounds are field-specific semantic contracts. Backend rejects overflow with actionable validation; it never truncates. UTF-8 byte count is len(value.encode('utf-8')). Pure preflight enforces raw bounds before normalization/parser expansion; post-normalization bounds are enforced again where applicable.

text_fields.rule: complete accepted value is normalized under UNICODE_MATCH_V1; no truncation/substr extraction

text_fields.additional: channel-kind definition may impose a lower bound/grammar; EMAIL_CHANNEL_V1 validates complete value and performs no truncation/DNS lookup

text_fields.newline: normalize accepted CRLF/CR input to LF before validation/persistence only for this multiline address contract

text_fields.rule: closed code/category value where supplied, not arbitrary narrative
opaque reference to governed review evidence, never free-form review narrative

page_policy.cursor: opaque bounded server-issued cursor; invalid/oversized cursor rejected rather than interpreted as SQL
rules: candidate/blocker/list/history pages use these defaults unless a more restrictive owning contract applies
visible page size never changes exact ambiguity/eligibility state
ordinary navigation uses keyset cursors rather than OFFSET over large tables

collections.page_policy: default 50 / max 200; no unbounded Contact detail expansion

collections.overflow: exact_count + continuation; never treat omitted blockers as eligibility
exact candidate_count + continuation; state remains AMBIGUOUS regardless of visible page

settings: Each SettingDefinition supplies its own max_utf8_bytes/depth/collection bounds; LLD-02 has no universal setting-value size constant beyond LLD-01 absolute parser safety ceilings.
ui_handoff: LLD-10 may show grapheme-aware counters/warnings for human-facing fields, but server acceptance remains governed by these field-specific bounds and semantic validators.
